verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.

For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

verses.text: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”

xrefs.text: Why should the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.
Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”

verses.text: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.

xrefs.text: For You cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas, and the current swirled about me; all Your breakers and waves swept over me.
Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.
Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah
